description: a project's settings give it its own commit identity. The server runs in workspace mode. Project {{NAME}} exists. The test mocks the server's exe.dev endpoints (GitHub connected) and the commit identity suggestions (none). Call "commit-identity" returns the saved commit identity of {{NAME}}. "The editor" is {"role": "region", "name": "Edit project", "exact": true}, the element section[aria-label='Edit project']; things "in the editor" are scoped to it (a selector after "section[aria-label='Edit project'] ", or {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, ...} for a role). To "open the editor of P": click "section[aria-label='P'] a.project-select", then click {"within": {"selector": "[data-testid='project-view']", "role": "navigation"}, "role": "button", "name": "Settings", "exact": true}. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Click the button "Open tasks". 3. Open the editor of {{NAME}}. 4. The checkbox data-testid "commit-identity-default" in the editor is checked: eval with expect "true" of String(document.querySelector("section[aria-label='Edit project'] [data-testid='commit-identity-default']").checked). 5. Uncheck it: click it, then the same eval has expect "false". 6. Fill "section[aria-label='Edit project'] [data-testid='commit-identity-name']" with "Grace Hopper" and "section[aria-label='Edit project'] [data-testid='commit-identity-email']" with "grace@example.com". 7. Set the viewport to 1100x1400 (set_viewport, keeping the device's scale, mobile and touch). 8. Click {"role": "button", "name": "Save project"} (page-wide, not exact). 9. {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, "role": "status"} contains "Saved" (assert_text_contains). 10. Call "commit-identity" with expect '{"email":"grace@example.com","name":"Grace Hopper"}'.
